title: CLI: concurrent index to same output succeeds (race condition)
description:
Running two index operations to the same output directory at the same time succeeds for both, which indicates a race condition in the lock file mechanism. The lock should prevent concurrent access.

## Reproduction
```
$ doc_transformer index /tmp/source --output /tmp/concurrent_test &
[1] 12345
$ doc_transformer index /tmp/source --output /tmp/concurrent_test &
[2] 12346
$ wait
# Both processes complete successfully (should have failed)
``"

Expected: One process should fail with "Another index operation appears to be running"
Actual: Both succeed, corrupting the index
